## Highlights
### New
- Crest 0.7 brings Chromium and WebKit together on Mac, with Chrome Web Store extensions and engine choices for each website. iPhone and iPad continue to use WebKit.
### Improved
- Pause and resume Chromium downloads, and recover interrupted transfers when the server supports it. - Chromium can show local service-worker and extension notifications while Crest runs, with Space access and notification permissions respected.
### Fixed
- Protected-video pages still switch to WebKit automatically. Engine switches respect unsaved-changes prompts and remember the website only after the move is allowed. - Interrupted Chromium profile upgrades resume safely without losing track of your existing browsing profiles. - Crest updates advertise the macOS version the whole app requires, so older Macs are not offered an incompatible update. - Crest windows on Mac no longer keep the system's WindowServer busy, which could use a lot of CPU on large or high-refresh external displays. The focused-window transparency setting has been removed.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
